title: You Think Brain Chips Control Thoughts, Yet Delgado's Bull Only Turned on Motor Circuits
description:
You think raging instinct cannot be stopped by a button! Yet one radio click halted a charging bull! This is the true story of Jose Delgado's Stimoceiver Bull Experiment. Here is what went wrong with the myth of blind rage.
